task.title: Fix contact search to include email, title, notes, products fields
task.description: In renderContacts(), the search filter currently only checks c.name and c.company. Change the filter condition from: if(q&&!c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)&&!c.company.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false; to: if(q){const ql=q.toLowerCase();if(!c.name.toLowerCase().includes(ql)&&!c.company.toLowerCase().includes(ql)&&!(c.email||'').toLowerCase().includes(ql)&&!(c.title||'').toLowerCase().includes(ql)&&!(c.notes||'').toLowerCase().includes(ql)&&!(c.products||'').toLowerCase().includes(ql))return false;} Also add a sort dropdown to the contacts toolbar: <select class="filter-select" id="ctSortF"><option value="priority">Priority</option><option value="lastContact">Last Contact</option><option value="company">Company A-Z</option><option value="name">Name A-Z</option><option value="spend">Annual Spend</option></select>. Wire it: in renderContacts() after filtering, sort based on ctSortF value — priority uses existing computePriority, lastContact sorts ascending by c.lastContact date string, company and name sort alphabetically, spend sorts descending by c.annualSpend. Add event listener: document.getElementById('ctSortF').addEventListener('change',renderContacts);

blocking_issues: Message truncation in queue items (120 chars) and drafts (100 chars) is too aggressive - users cannot meaningfully review messages before sending, creating risk of sending inappropriate content
No email validation before opening compose windows - invalid/empty email addresses will create broken mailto links or failed web compose attempts
Delete contact operation has no loading state or confirmation that related queue/draft items will be deleted - users may not realize pending messages are being removed
Guide modal has no mobile responsive design - fixed positioning at 340px width will overflow on small screens (<360px), making it unusable
Guide button at bottom:28px right:28px will overlap with floating action buttons or footer elements on mobile devices
Guide input field lacks accessible label - screen readers cannot identify the purpose of the input (only has placeholder)
Close button 'x' has no accessible label/aria-label - screen readers will announce it as just 'button'
Modal has no focus trap - keyboard users can tab out of the modal to underlying content, breaking accessibility
Mobile navigation inaccessible - sidebar is fixed at 230px with no mobile menu or responsive behavior, making all navigation unusable on screens <600px
Modal scrolling broken on mobile - modal content may be cut off on small screens with max-height:92vh and padding, no guaranteed scrollability
Form inputs lack accessible error announcements - error messages shown visually but no aria-live regions for screen readers
No focus trap in modals - keyboard users can tab outside modal to underlying content, breaking accessibility
Function renderQueue() is incomplete/truncated - the function body cuts off mid-statement at 'document.getElement', making the queue view completely non-functional

No error handling for missing contact data when opening history - if gc() returns empty or contact is deleted, critical functions like computePriority() and computeTrigger() will crash with undefined reference errors

onclick handlers in dynamically generated HTML use string concatenation with IDs that could contain quotes/special chars - creates XSS vulnerability and will break JavaScript execution (e.g., 'sendEmail(\''+q.id+'\')' fails if q.id contains quotes)
Guide modal has max-height:480px but no mobile responsive breakpoint - will overflow on smaller screens. Need @media query to adjust height/width for mobile viewports.
